# Official press releases: release-source (PRESS)

One publisher of official news (a central bank, a regulator, a government): its latest releases newest first, each a link, and its terms. One row per official press releases, keyed by SOURCE_ID. Read by the **official-news** pack's connector `officialnews-store` (table `<root>/officialnews/release-source/`). There is **no committed test data** for this kind: the sample comes from the pack's samples (`config/packs/official-news/samples/release-source.jsonl`, 9 records). A bank or a public refresh delivers it in the same JSON Lines shape.

## File layout

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Path | `config/packs/official-news/samples/release-source.jsonl` |
| Format | JSON Lines: UTF-8, one JSON object a line |
| Key field | `SOURCE_ID` |
| Date field | none in the record: the pack's samples are served on every business date (partition `business_date`) |
| Promoted columns | none (the whole record is kept as `doc`) |
| Vector fields | none |
| Partitioned by | `business_date` |
| A day's file | no committed files |

## One sample record

A real record, the most complete of the 9 (the one with the most non-empty fields), pretty-printed with two-space indents. **A string such as `"… 506 more numbers"` inside an array marks a fold**: it stands for the elements left out and is not part of the data.

## Field reference

Every field of the record above, nested ones as dotted paths (`[]` marks an array of objects). *Required* is the contract's; *in N%* is how often the test data fills it.

| Field | Type | Required | Meaning | Values, format, unit | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `BY_CATEGORY` | array of objects | required | The kept releases counted by category (CATEGORY, COUNT), the largest first. | — | [1 objects] |
| `BY_CATEGORY[].CATEGORY` | string | required | The category, Uncategorised when the feed gives none. | — | `"Uncategorised"` |
| `BY_CATEGORY[].COUNT` | integer | required | How many kept releases have that category. | — | `12` |
| `COUNTRY` | string | required | The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code of the publisher's country (EMU for the euro area). | seen: `CAN`, `USA`, `EMU`, `GBR` | `"GBR"` |
| `FEED_URL` | string | required | The address the feed reads (RSS, Atom, or the Federal Register's API). | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/rss/news"` |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | seen: `false`, `true` | `true` |
| `LAST_PUBLISHED` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | optional (filled in every row) | When the newest kept release was published (UTC). | — | `"2026-11-05T12:00:00Z"` |
| `LAST_PULL` | string | required | ok, or failed (the kept releases are shown) when the publisher's feed could not be read. | — | `"ok"` |
| `LATEST` | array of objects | required | The newest 25 releases, newest first: PUBLISHED, TITLE, URL, CATEGORY and PRESS_RELEASE. | — | [12 objects] |
| `LATEST[].PRESS_RELEASE` | string | required | The release's page in Drishti (PREL-...). | pattern `^PREL-`; links to `press-release` | `"PREL-BOE-26D3012260"` |
| `LATEST[].PUBLISHED` | timestamp (ISO-8601) | required | When the release was published (UTC). | — | `"2026-11-05T12:00:00Z"` |
| `LATEST[].TITLE` | string | required | The release's title. | — | `"Bank rate increased to 4% - November 2026 Monetary Policy …` |
| `LATEST[].URL` | string | required | The release on the publisher's site. | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/monetary-policy-summary-an…` |
| `LICENCE` | string | required | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"Bank of England copyright: download, display or print for …` |
| `NAME` | string | required | The publisher's name. | — | `"Bank of England"` |
| `PROVENANCE` | object | required | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. | — | {…} |
| `PROVENANCE.ATTRIBUTION` | string | required | The credit line to repeat when the release is shown or republished. | — | `"Source: Bank of England."` |
| `PROVENANCE.DATASET` | string | required | The publisher's feed the record was read from. | — | `"Bank of England: press releases"` |
| `PROVENANCE.INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required | True when the publisher's terms allow no commercial reuse: the record stays inside the organisation (Export data refuses it). | seen: `false`, `true` | `true` |
| `PROVENANCE.LICENCE` | string | required | The publisher's terms of reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | — | `"Bank of England copyright: download, display or print for …` |
| `PROVENANCE.RETRIEVED_AT` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | required | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | — | `"2026-11-06"` |
| `PROVENANCE.SOURCE` | string | required | The publisher. | — | `"Bank of England"` |
| `PROVENANCE.URL` | string | required | The original on the publisher's site. | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news"` |
| `PUBLISHER_TYPE` | string | required | What the publisher is. | one of `central bank`, `regulator`, `government` | `"central bank"` |
| `RELEASES` | integer | required | How many releases are kept (the last keep-days, at most keep-per-source). | seen: `12`, `10`, `5`, `8` | `12` |
| `SOURCE_ID` | string | required | PRESS- and the publisher's id in the feed's YAML (FED, ECB, BOC, BOE, SEC, OSFI, FEDREG, GAZETTE1, GAZETTE2). | pattern `^PRESS-` | `"PRESS-BOE"` |
| `TERMS_URL` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The publisher's terms page. | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/legal"` |
| `WEBSITE` | string | optional (filled in every row) | The publisher's page of releases. | — | `"https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/news"` |
| `WHY_INTERNAL` | string | optional (filled in 44% of rows) | Why the publisher's releases are internal only, in words; empty when they are not. | — | `"The Bank of England allows personal and internal non-comme…` |

## For the production query

- **Identity:** one record per `SOURCE_ID` per `snapshot`; the key is text, unique within the date.
- **Never null:** `SOURCE_ID`, `NAME`, `PUBLISHER_TYPE`, `COUNTRY`, `FEED_URL`, `LICENCE`, `INTERNAL_ONLY`, `RELEASES`, `LAST_PULL`, `LATEST`, `BY_CATEGORY`, `PROVENANCE` (the contract's required fields); every row of the test data also fills `LAST_PUBLISHED`, `TERMS_URL`, `WEBSITE`.
- **Format:** JSON Lines, UTF-8, one object a line, gzip; field names exactly as shown (UPPER_SNAKE); dates `YYYY-MM-DD`; numbers as JSON numbers, never strings; a missing value is `null` or absent (an empty string is read as empty).
- **Arrays:** keep the order shown (vectors in the scenario set's or the run's order); nested objects as JSON, never flattened.
- Unique: `SOURCE_ID` per snapshot.
- `SOURCE_ID` matches `^PRESS-`.
- `BY_CATEGORY[].COUNT` is at least 0.
